claim.claim-text: 1. A debridement device having a wound contacting layer for debridement of a wound, comprising:
a layer of gel-forming fibres; and a plurality of bristles in contact with the gel-forming fibres.
2. The device of claim 1, wherein the plurality of bristles protrude perpendicularly from the layer of gelling fibres.
3. The device of claim 1, wherein the layer of gel-forming fibres are woven or knitted.
4. The device of claim 1, wherein the layer of gel-forming fibres have an absorbency of at least 10 g/g and resists lateral spread of a fluid upon absorption.
5. The device of claim 1, wherein the layer of gel-forming fibres comprise sodium carboxymethylcellulose that has a degree of substitution of at least 0.05 carboxymethyl groups per cellulose unit.
6. The device of claim 1, further comprising anti-biofilm agents, metal chelators, surfactants, or any combination thereof.

7. The device of claim 1, further comprising a diagnostic unit in fluid communication with the layer of gel-forming fibres, wherein the diagnostic unit comprises at least one of an enzyme-based assay or an electronic sensor.
8. The device of claim 7, wherein the diagnostic unit comprises one or more diagnostic disks, comprising:
9. The device of claim 1, further comprising a handle attached to a non-wound-contacting surface of the device.
10. The device of claim 9 wherein the handle is a stick.

11. The device of claim 10 wherein the layer of gel-forming fibres is arranged in a layered structure that comprises support materials; wherein the support materials form a base layer that is in contact with the layer of gel-forming fibres.
12. The device of claim 11 wherein the debridement device is arranged on one end of the stick; the layer of gel-forming fibres is absorbent; and the plurality of bristles are a pile of monofilaments.
13. The device of claim 12 wherein the base layer is surrounded by gelling fibres from which a pile of monofilaments protrude.
14. A kit for debridement of a wound, comprising:

15. The kit of claim 14, further comprising: a diagnostic unit in fluid communication with the debridement device, wherein the diagnostic unit comprises at least one of an enzyme-based assay, an electronic sensor, or one or more reagents for indicating infection of the wound.
